create.name: Shannon Murphy
create.bio:
Shannon Murphy, who also works as Shannon K. Murphy, is a hypnotherapist and coach whose work blends money mindset coaching with spiritual practice. Her own path began in 2003, when a series of past life regressions changed how she understood her relationships and her life lessons, and in 2016 she took a professional regression training led by Dr. Brian Weiss, held at Omega in Rhinebeck, New York. She also uses EFT tapping, guided visualisation, meditation and Reiki.

Much of her teaching is aimed at women, often coaches and practitioners running heart-led businesses, who want to look at the beliefs about money and worth they absorbed as children. Her seven-week Conscious Money course and a ninety-day group mastermind take students through those patterns with tapping scripts and visualisations. Alongside this she offers one-to-one past life regression and life-between-lives sessions over Zoom, cord-cutting sessions, distance Reiki, custom recorded meditations and occasional group hypnosis gatherings. She shares free tapping meditations through her online shop and guided practices on Insight Timer.

courses.title: Conscious Money Course
courses.description: A self-paced seven-week online course with a new video lesson each week. Students map their beliefs and feelings about five kinds of money and build personal tapping scripts and visualisations to work with them.

courses.title: Conscious Money Mastermind
courses.description: A ninety-day group programme that opens with a one-to-one session, includes the Conscious Money course, and continues with ten weekly group calls using tapping and guided visualisation on childhood money beliefs.

courses.title: Past Life Regression Session
courses.description: A seventy-five-minute one-to-one session on Zoom in which she guides you into a deep, quiet state to explore earlier lifetimes, soul connections and the lessons they carry. Series of three are also offered.

courses.title: Remembering Your Soul's Plan: A Guided Journey
courses.description: A private guided session exploring the time between lives and the plan the soul may have made for this one.

courses.title: Cutting Energetic Cords
courses.description: A sixty-minute live one-to-one session focused on releasing energetic ties to people and situations.

courses.title: Reiki Distance Session
courses.description: A remote Reiki session of about forty-five to sixty minutes, received while resting at home at the agreed time.

free_resources.title: Shannon Murphy on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Her guided meditations on the Insight Timer app, free to play.

free_resources.title: Healing Limiting Money Beliefs Tapping Meditation
free_resources.description: A free guided tapping practice on old beliefs about money, offered as a download from her shop.

free_resources.title: Morning EFT Tapping Meditation
free_resources.description: A short free tapping meditation for settling and grounding at the start of the day.
